name: processtask_collection_formattribute
label: Work Order and Form Attribute Value Relationship Table
description: The table connects work orders to form attribute values, suitable for querying related associations in workflow scenarios.

fields.name: collection_id
fields.description: Work order collection ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: form_attribute_data_id
fields.description: Form attribute values ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the collection_id, form_attribute_data_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
